verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal ships prebuilt email receipts that already include all card-network-required fields, which delivers the core of the story. It also exposes receipt data through the API so merchants can build custom, on-brand receipts, provided they list the required information. Missing for 10: SMS receipt delivery, a built-in printed-receipt capability (printing relies on a custom build from receipt data), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can issue digital (email/SMS) or printed receipts that meet card-network requirements

citations.quote: Prebuilt email receipts already include all card network-required fields.
You can use Stripe’s prebuilt email receipts, or use receipt data from the Stripe API and your Terminal integration to generate on-brand custom receipts.
You can also customize receipts to include any design and content you want—as long as you list required information.
